title: Granting a Hardship Deferral on a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Account
content:
**Policy.** A deferral answers a hardship request the borrower has filed, is booked on the account dated the day it is granted, names the first statement period it covers and the consecutive months it covers, and marks the request approved. The request answered is the most recent hardship request on the account whose status is submitted. The months granted are fixed only after the account carries a submitted hardship request from the borrower stating the months asked for. A deferral is not granted until the account carries a monthly-interest entry for every statement period whose due date has passed. A deferral is granted only when the account was funded at least the stated number of full calendar months before the request. For a hardship request on an account whose plan carries no promotion (a fixed-rate or low-payment plan) that this policy decides, and only for such a request, a request that fails the seasoning, plan-offer or days-past-due condition is declined, and a request that meets them is granted for the months set out in this policy even where they differ from the months asked; how many months a borrower may ask for remains with the hardship request rules; a request on an account whose plan carries a promotion remains under the base hardship rules.

Scheduled payments whose due date has already passed stay due: a deferral never covers such a period, and those payments keep their own grace periods and late fee rules. Deferred payments move to the end of the term; interest keeps accruing and a promotional end date is never extended. The plan attributes that give the most months one hardship deferral may cover and the most months of deferral over the life of the account describe the base hardship rules; for a request this policy decides, the months granted are bounded by the months asked, which the hardship request rules bound by the hardship offer. This policy belongs to Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing.

## Records the grant rests on

| Record on the account | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Hardship request | The months granted are fixed only once a submitted hardship request from the borrower stating the months asked for is on the account |
| Monthly-interest entries | No grant until every statement period whose due date has passed carries a monthly-interest entry |
| Funded date | Funded at least the plan's stated number of full calendar months before the request |

## Invocation

The tool is `post_finance_hardship_deferral_5a1cdd93`. It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it. The deferral is booked on the account history dated the day it is granted, with no amount charged, and the hardship request it answers is marked approved; the borrower sees the deferral and the approved request at once.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `finance_account_id` | The reference number of the financing account the deferral is granted on, as returned by the financing account lookup | Identifier |
| `finance_hardship_request_id` | The reference number of the hardship request the deferral answers, as returned by the hardship request lookup or by the filing of the request | Identifier |
| `statement_period` | The first statement period the deferral covers | YYYY-MM; never empty |
| `deferral_months` | The consecutive months deferred | A non-negative integer count of whole months |

## Return

A successful call returns `finance_txn_id` (the reference number of the deferral entry), `finance_account_id`, `finance_hardship_request_id` (the request answered), `statement_period` (YYYY-MM, the first period deferred), `deferral_months` (the months deferred), `request_status` (the word approved) and `status` (the word granted when the deferral was booked).
